input:
The standard deviation of the following distribution is

Class intervals: 0-6, 6-12, 12-18
Frequencies: 2, 4, 6

Options:
A. 5sqrt(2)
B. sqrt(5)
C. 2sqrt(5)
D. 20

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Find standard deviation for grouped data using class marks and frequencies.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Use class midpoints xi and the formula variance = (sum fi xi^2)/N - ((sum fi xi)/N)^2.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Create midpoint table, compute required sums, then evaluate variance and standard deviation.
logical_steps: Step 3: Sum columns and total frequency N
Step 5: Take square root and match option

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Using grouped-data variance formula gives sigma^2=20, so sigma=2sqrt(5).
